description.value: Sharkey's Fish Locker is a seasonal wild Pacific fish processor and takeout shop in Roberts Creek on the Sunshine Coast, house-smoking salmon, halibut, black cod, and other local species on site. The takeout window serves Fish & Chips alongside a deli case of ready-made seafood meals — pierogies, wellingtons, quiche, and lasagne — most available fresh or frozen. For touring cyclists, it offers an unusual opportunity to eat well on the road or carry shelf-stable smoked fish for later.

address.value: 1397 Roberts Creek Road, Roberts Creek, BC V0N 2W1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's menu page confirms this is an active seasonal business (open April 24–September 30, 2026) at 1397 Roberts Creek Road with phone 604-885-0844, corroborating both OSM fields.
